description: Test suite for the EncryptionService, testing encryption/decryption, error handling, configuration value encryption, and edge cases.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_EncryptDecrypt_Roundtrip
methods.description: Tests that data encrypted and then decrypted returns the original plaintext.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_EncryptDecrypt_EmptyString
methods.description: Tests encryption and decryption of an empty string.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_EncryptDecrypt_DifferentNonces
methods.description: Ensures that encrypting the same plaintext multiple times results in different ciphertexts due to random nonces, but decrypts back to the original plaintext.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_EncryptDecrypt_WrongKey
methods.description: Verifies that decryption with a wrong key results in an error.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_EncryptDecrypt_InvalidCiphertext
methods.description: Tests decryption failure when ciphertext is invalid base64.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_EncryptDecrypt_CorruptedData
methods.description: Checks decryption failure when ciphertext data is corrupted.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_EncryptDecrypt_TooShort
methods.description: Tests decryption failure when ciphertext is shorter than expected.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_EncryptConfigurationValues
methods.description: Tests encryption of configuration values, ensuring secret fields are encrypted and others remain unchanged.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_DecryptConfigurationValues
methods.description: Tests decryption of configuration values, ensuring secret fields are decrypted correctly.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_EncryptConfigurationValues_NonStringValue
methods.description: Verifies that non-string secret values are left unchanged during encryption.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_EncryptConfigurationValues_MissingField
methods.description: Ensures that missing fields in configuration are handled gracefully.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_DecryptConfigurationValues_InvalidCiphertext
methods.description: Checks error handling when decrypting invalid ciphertext in configuration.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_KeyDerivation_Consistency
methods.description: Verifies that the same passphrase results in consistent encryption/decryption across services.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_KeyDerivation_DifferentPassphrases
methods.description: Ensures that different passphrases produce different keys and prevent decryption.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_LongPlaintext
methods.description: Tests encryption and decryption of a long plaintext string.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_SpecialCharacters
methods.description: Verifies encryption/decryption of plaintext with special characters.
